messages.text: Did you ever update that March money tab or is it already fossilized
It has three heroic rows from Saturday and then a big blank stretch
Classic. Put tires-for-truck at the top in giant letters and send me a screenshot after game night
Fine, but if I rename it something dramatic you have to pretend it was your idea
Truck's under a quarter tank. If you're taking Emily after school, put in ten from the kitchen drawer.
Okay. I can take her. I don't have anything on the calendar until Caleb later.
Good. And don't count on a Friday deposit that isn't coming. We'll talk after supper.
Swing by the shop before you take Emily. Left rear bulb looked weak last night.
Again? I do not need another roadside lecture over a tiny red light.
Then fix it before Main. Five minutes, no drama.
Fine. I still have that yellow slip in the glove box reminding me.
Need the garage outlet clear by supper. You still got that tablet cord and camera stand plugged in out there?
Yeah, I was using the bench for the blue-jacket guy's face sheet and a 20 sec truck-door clip. I'll move it.
Leave the little light if you need it. Just don't trip over the extension cord again.
Mom says take the gray hoodie from the dryer if you are driving me. It is still cold.
I grabbed it. The zipper is stuck again but it works.
Also don't forget my gym bag. The one by the shoes, not the trash pile by your door.
Mom asked if your phone is dead because Jenna texted twice and you didn't answer.
Did you watch that 12-min YouTube thing I sent or just leave it in your tabs forever
Watched half. Then pulled up the Sundance Times piece because the comment section was melting my brain.
Not dead. Just stacked up. I also slept weird and had gas station coffee for lunch, so I'm not winning today.
Go do your no-earbuds lap before you start watching drawing-process videos and pretending it's homework.
Mom said NPR had a shorter clip too. Dinner is gonna be everyone comparing links again lol
Fine. Twenty minutes, then I can look at the clip you roasted yesterday.
Fine by me. I'd rather sort it out at the table than throw a hot take online.
Are you keeping the couch or is Dad taking over after dinner?
Couch is ours until the Denver pregame starts. Then I need the big TV for at least the first period.
Fine. But we are doing two Star Harbor episodes after. I want to hear your awful captain voice again.
Deal, but snacks are on you if they blow the lead before 8.
Did you send Tyler the rough square yet, or are you still moving the same red layer around forever?
Sent a low-res version. Waiting to see if he wants the title tucked behind the guitar neck.
Good. Put the $35 marker in your notes before you forget and accidentally do it for snacks.
Already wrote it down, plus a poster crop if he actually likes it.
County library table is booked for Thursday. Bring the diner scene with an actual ending this time.
I keep changing the last two pages.
Send me the rough version by 9 tonight. Ugly ending beats no ending.
Also you got weirdly quiet after the form email. Eat something before you stare at it again.
Did you finish the tavern scene or are you still watching helmet-painting speed vids?
Did you send the three animation stills or are you still sharpening the same shadow again?
I paused the one with the horned armor at the brush setup part. It actually fixed the silhouette problem.
Still staring at it. The packet feels good until the form asks where I stopped, then I want to close the tab.
Fine, that counts as work-adjacent. Send me the new panel before you fall into another 40-minute camera-blocking breakdown.
Put the answer in the tiny box, then go back to making the monster blink. Tiny box does not get to eat the whole night.
Already in the queue after the storyboard timing one. Then panel, promise.
Fair. I can do ten minutes on the box and twenty on the blink test.
I put the county page, clinic handout, and the CDC printout by your sketchbook. The pharmacist's note is clipped on top.
Thanks. I was trying to compare them before I decide on the booster thing.
Also call that Gillette office before noon. Ask if they still do the reduced-rate phone slots or if the wait list changed.
I will. Last time the only opening was during Emily's pickup, so maybe phone would work.
Can you swing by the school at 4:40? Emily forgot her binder again and Dan's still out on that repair call.
Yeah. I'll grab her, then come straight back before supper.
Thanks. Also, if Dan is quiet at the table, it is about the truck estimate, not you.
Good to know. I kept thinking he saw the unopened GED folder on the counter.
Did you open the community college email yet, or is it still sitting unread?
Still unread. I got as far as the subject line and then cleaned the whole desk instead.
Come sit at the kitchen table for ten minutes. Just open it, no decisions tonight.
Okay. If there is a date I missed, you read it first.
Red Lantern after soccer has a table for four. Need me to save you a second chair?
Board game after my shift, or are you still going to that courthouse thing about the creek buffers and fiber lines?
Nope, just me and my mud-covered cleats.
Going for the first half. If they only talk like Casper is the whole state, I'm leaving.
Also did you answer Maya from open mic or are you still building a legal brief in the typing box?
Bring up the west road dead zone. My phone becomes a brick past the cattle guard.
Drafts app: five versions. Sent box: zero. Very productive disaster.
Already on my notes, right under library hours and the clinic rooms that are booked forever.
Shop says the truck tire and alignment would be $412 if they do both.
I can put in maybe $80 today. The little bank app bucket is showing $286 before gas.
Use cash or your regular bank card for your part. I can front the rest if you help me Saturday morning.
Okay. I can do the gate hinges and sweep the shop too.
Mom said you left the county envelope on the counter again. Is it trash or important?
Important-ish. It has the school board names and the library thing I meant to read.
your insta slide 3 has the weird hand still
Then maybe don't bury it under sketch paper this time.
I know. I put it in the server first and two people circled the same thumb.
Fair. Can you put it by my keys? I need the deadline box too.
fix thumb before you post. also mom said check the fb thing for the library movie night
Doing the hand pass in Krita, then I'll check the event page.
Mom says don't lose the old recipe cards again. The one with the cabbage rolls has Grandma Keller's handwriting on it.
I put them in the blue folder with the O'Neill cemetery photos.
Good because I need the bread one for school and your folder system looks like a tornado.
Why is the kitchen table covered in geyser photos and that green notebook?
Trying to pull two decent sketches before I use the big paper on portfolio stuff.
The horn girl turnaround looks better now but her hands still look like forks.
Rude but fair. I fixed the layer mess in Krita and will redraw those before I export.
The bison one is less bad. Also Mom said don't forget the GED form pile under it.
Yeah, I moved the map tabs so I can actually see the forms.
Also the little walking clip finally loops without that weird ankle snap.
Good. I still have to drop the clip beside the swamp ruins image on the page tonight.
Are you still awake or did the big pot thing win
Still up. Beans are behaving, carrots are almost done, and I found the coffee I abandoned in the microwave.
Save me some of the crunchy carrot pieces. Also your trail mix bag is on the couch again.
That bag is load-bearing. I need it until the pot is actually edible.
Did you upload the two portfolio pieces or are you still swapping the alley sketch back in?
I opened the form, then started fixing the shadows on the second page again.
Send me one screenshot when the button is gray. I am not reading version 17 tonight.
Fine. I put the cutoff time in the sheet too so you can yell before it disappears.
You in for Sunday? We need another body or Nate is putting me in goal again.
Yeah. I found my cleats and the blue jersey. Going to keep the tape in my bag just in case.
Good. Also do the boring warmup this time. Last spring you tried to skip it and walked like a grandpa for a week.
I remember. I'm not testing it on day one.
Grab the furnace filters if you pass Ace. Size is on the fridge note.
I can get those and dish soap. Still four-pack filters?
Yep. Keep the receipt on the counter. Your mom and I will square up after supper.
Got it. I'll also set out four plates before Emily gets back.
Mom says dinner is 6:30. Also your notebook is on the kitchen table again.
Can you leave it there? I still need my three lines after I do the floor routine.
Fine. But move the mat before I trip over it trying to get cereal.
I will. Just doing the breathing timer first.
You still in for the ridge loop after I get off at the store?
Yeah. I swapped shifts so I can make it. Shoes are already in the truck.
Good. Also bring cleats if the school field isn't mud soup.
Packed both. My legs are going to hate you by dinner.
Your mom found the blue folder in the hall closet. Spearfish copy is in there.
Good. Does it have the Sundance house stuff too?
Yep. Utility letter from when you were 16, plus my license copy. I'll leave it by the truck keys.
Thanks. I need it before the passport counter closes.
If you take the Chevy to Caleb's, check the gauge first. It was near a quarter last night.
I'll look. If it coughs again I'll just go past the Millers' fence and be there in ten.
Fine. Shut the gate tight. That brown dog from two houses over was nosing around the yard.
Got it. Mr. Holt already did the two-finger wave from his driveway when I grabbed the mail.
You taking the truck to the library before supper?
Yeah. Need to haul the folding stands and that box of blank notebooks.
Put the six-string in the back seat, not the bed. Wind is ugly.
Good call. I still need it after the kids clear out.
Can you stop doing the same four-chord thing before my show starts
Two more takes. The mic kept catching chair squeaks.
Use headphones then. Also the drum loop you added sounds like a toy parade.
Fair. I am muting that track and keeping the clean take.
Send the diner booth scene before midnight. I don't care if the last line is still ugly.
It's two pages now. I also made the waitress's hands way too huge in the tablet file, so she's currently a cryptid.
Huge hands can stay. Fix the pause after 'you locked the freezer?' and stop repainting her eyebrows.
Fine. I'll export the pages first, then do one more pass on the boards.
Mrs. Hensley said the library desk helper form is still at circulation if you want to look at it today.
I can stop in after lunch. If it is mostly shelves and program setup, that sounds less awful than a rush counter.
Ask what days they actually need covered. Do not nod yes to every morning just because the form is in front of you.
Yeah. I wrote Tue/Thu/Sat first, maybe one extra if it is later in the day.
Truck has enough gas for Gillette if you still want me to drive you Thursday.
Yeah. The outreach office said I can just sit with someone and compare the cheap route with the online layout class.
Good. Ask what you pay up front and what comes later. Do not sign up blind.
I printed the practice test dates too. Trying to line it up so I am not paying for everything at once.
Truck has enough gas for after service?
Yeah, I filled it yesterday. Laura said Ruth wanted me there before the folding chairs disappear.
Take the green tie-downs. Ed will ask twice if you forget.
Already in the bed. I'll swing by their place after the coffee hour cleanup.
Are you still doing the hill thing or can you drive me to Mia's at 5?
I just got back. Dirt on my shoes, sky looked ridiculous, pine smell all over my hoodie.
Gross but fine. You sound less weird than this morning.
Truck is already pointed downhill. I'll rinse off and take you.
The windmill monster looks less dumb now. Still walks like Dad's jack.
That walk is staying. It came from watching the real jack stick behind the shed.
Fine. But fix the eyes before you send it to those people in the midnight thread.
Doing it myself tonight. If they rip it apart, at least it is my weird Sundance shed creature.
You free after the field dries? Nets are still in my truck from Saturday.
Yeah, I can do an hour. My left foot is still garbage, so keep the trash talk reasonable.
No promises. Also Thursday I want a rematch with the red corporation because your heat track nonsense was illegal in spirit.
It was legal and beautiful. I'll bring the rulebook so you can lose officially.
Mom says don't forget the folding chairs tonight. Also you left your muddy shoes by the door again.
I know. Ridge was wet this morning. I'll grab the chairs after I rinse them off.
The old ladies will roast you if you track dirt into the basement room.
Fair. Tell Mom I'll be there before the soup table gets crowded.
Soccer at 7 if you don't vanish into that same file again.
I keep checking the upload page, then reopening the portfolio like the bad panel is moving around.
Set the alarm. When it rings, send whatever exists. Then come run.
Alarm is set for 6:20. Jenna gets proof after.
Mom said don't use the front table for drawing tonight. She has bank papers spread out.
The blue folder again?
Yeah, the one with Dad's initials all over it. Also she wants you to mop the hallway before dinner.
I'll do it. Tell her I already picked up paper towels, so that's off the list.
You coming to indoor pickup or did the uniforms by the west door scare you off?
I am coming. I just hate walking past them when they all do the look-at-the-parking-lot thing.
They are there every tournament. Same two guys as fair parking.
I know. Still makes my hands check the steering wheel like that bulb night.
Garage game at 7. You coming or doing the disappearing act?
Garage game still at 7? I can push Mars setup if your Belle Fourche call runs long.
Trying to come. Dad asked about money again and the application wants dates from the year I bailed on the regular building.
It got moved again. They said the cheaper slot is next Wednesday at 9, which is terrible timing.
Bring the laptop. Between turns, fill in two boxes. If you crater my engine strategy while doing paperwork, I respect it.
Classic. Bring the papers your mom printed and I'll drive by the pharmacy before we start if you want.
Yeah, I want to ask them one more thing before I stop overthinking the clinic sheet.
Deal. I need out of my room anyway before I rewrite the same two lines until midnight.
Dude from the garage band asked if your skull-and-cassette thing was yours.
Garage tomorrow after work? Also I sent the local station clip, not the yelling guy link.
Yeah. If he wants something similar I need the song title, deadline, and actual money first.
Yeah. I want to hear what your uncle said too before I decide what to share.
I told him you also fixed my cousin's crooked mower logo, so he may ask about that too.
That's fine. I can do the cleanup faster than drawing a whole front image.
He mostly said read the whole article first, which is painfully adult of him.
Good rule. I'll bring the YouTube breakdown and we can argue after Terraforming Mars.
Mom says if you leave receipts in the cup holder again they become truck compost
Tell her the cup holder system is evolving. Also I found two from last week under the parking brake
Gross. Put them in the tire folder thing before Jenna asks and you make the doomed face
The doomed face is scheduled for 5 if I don't get the totals in
Are you leaving for Caleb's thing before dinner or after?
After. Tell Mom I only need like ten minutes to pack the box.
The giant space one? Caleb better not flip the table again if you steal his plants.
He didn't flip it. He just made the wounded face for twenty minutes.
Screenshot me the two-line version. Not the novel.
It sounds too casual if I say Friday, too intense if I say Saturday, and weird if I mention the movie.
Did you print the haunted gas-station prompt sheets or am I stealing napkins from the diner again?
Printed 18. Also trimmed the blank ending so they have room to wreck it.
You are arranging coffee, not negotiating a hostage exchange. Send the Friday line.
Good. And bring the bit where the mayor thinks the vending machine is a witness.
Sent. Phone is now across the room so I stop watching the little dots.
Only if you don't laugh before my second line this time.
I saw the porch light on after midnight and your cereal bowl untouched. Did the upload page freeze again?
No. I just kept rereading the requirements.
Then do the first checkbox before lunch. I put the library computer room hours on the fridge.
Okay. Jenna said she wants a screenshot when it is submitted.
I washed the black socks with the shin guards sleeve. They are on the dryer, not in your room.
Thanks. Caleb moved tonight to 6:30 because the field lights are working again.
Take the wrap from the hall basket. You said it was fine, but early March is not the time to be stubborn.
I'll pack it. It mostly feels normal now.
The library volunteer at the help desk said you can still bring the blank intake page back Monday.
I left the boxes empty for W-2 and 1099 because I don't have either.
That's fine. Also leave the prior-year line blank if there truly isn't one. Don't invent paperwork to make the form look normal.
Yeah. The only regular stuff I can list is library hours and helping at home.
Ranger booth at Bearlodge is asking who can do visitor maps once the snow backs off. You want me to send you the flyer?
Send it. If it is trail maps and not 6am mower stuff, I would actually read it.
It says weekdays plus some Saturdays. You would have to tell them your magic 'after normal people have coffee' hours.
Three days is easy to write down. Four if they are not stacked back to back.
Game store wants prepay for the Mars expansion, $38. Online checkout is being picky.
Can you grab mine and I will hand you cash Thursday? My bank card keeps acting weird on those forms.
Fine, but you owe me first pick of corporation next game.
Deal. I am trying not to touch the $270 sitting aside because the truck thing already ate my week.
Truck has gas. If you're driving Emily later, keys are by the coffee can.
Thanks. I'm doing the sit timer and writing the three things before I touch the GED tab.
Good. One thing at a time.
Set that wrapped bison package on the lower shelf. Do not leave it by the sink.
Moved it. I am doing the bean pot tomorrow, not tonight.
Good. Truck needs gas before you take Emily anywhere. Also use the old roasting pan if you cut up those roots.
Got it. Tonight is eggs and whatever is fastest.
Your little cable is still plugged into the amp by the bench.
Leave it there please. I need one clean pass into the laptop after supper.
Fine. Coil it when done so nobody trips.
Mom said you're taking me after dinner if Dad gets stuck at the shop.
Yeah. I need five minutes first because my laptop is on the bed and the pen caps are everywhere.
Again? I saw three sketchbooks under your blanket. Don't lose my permission slip in there.
Mom says stop digging through my school box for your forms.
It is on the dresser. If the Chevy is boxed in, we'll go the short way by the yellow house.
I only need the envelope from the Sundance address file. It has the old emergency contact page.
The one with Mom, Dad, me, and your terrible 2023 handwriting?
Unfortunately yes. Also don't bend the Spearfish copy if you see it.
Your wizard guy walks like the cereal mascot again.
Rude but useful. I found a short where someone flips between key poses and the limp is obvious now.
Also the cloak is better. Did you steal that from the dragon lady account?
Borrowed the edge-light trick, not the cloak. She did a good process reel.
You vanished from the roughs channel after posting the diner monster.
Saw the notes. Just got embarrassed and hid in the side DM.
Read the redlines, change two things, leave the rest. Also stop doom-scrolling reels while the file is open.
Fair. I saved the paintover and closed insta for now.
I can bring home the clerk office printout after my library shift. The online one is not exactly friendly.
Yes please. The party stuff is noise to me; I just want the short version of what touches the library, roads, and school money.
I'll mark the dates in pencil, but you need to put them in your phone yourself.
Deal. I missed enough small boxes by pretending I would remember.
When you fill the community booth card, use Keller on Dad's mother's side and O'Neill on mine. No need to get fancy.
So two recipe samples, the brown bread and the noodle one?
Yes. And check the spelling from the binder before you print anything.
Got it. I'll grab the binder after lunch.
I left the library copier card by your sketchbook. Did you scan the old transcript page yet?
Doing it after dinner. The form keeps asking for a current campus ID, and I do not have one to enter.
Then leave that blank and bring it to the desk Monday. Also keep the grant tab open before you look at paid programs.
I bookmarked the two-year campus page and the cheaper HTML course. No giant invoice jumpscare tonight.
Garage at noon or are you vanishing up by the Bighorn foothills again?
Foothills first. I can be there by 11:30 if I take the lower loop.
Lower loop means you stare at clouds for half an hour and call it walking.
Still counts. Bring the Mars board out before I get there.
Soccer at 1. You vanished after saying you were doing that online packet.
Packet is still half done. The page with boxes for school history made me shut the laptop.
Bring the laptop to my garage after practice. I will set a timer and annoy you every 8 minutes.
Fine. Also remind me to pay the $37 thing before I pretend I never saw it.
Garage game night still 6? I can set up Terraforming before you get here.
Maybe 6:45. Avs are on early and Emily already claimed the next couch slot for her dragon-school thing.
You scheduling your whole night around screens again.
Only when Denver is in it and she has been texting spoilers all afternoon.
Truck has half a tank. Roads by the foothills may be slick.
Thanks. I just want the quiet up there before everyone is awake.
Bring the socket set back when you stop by the hall. They said the pantry shelf is loose again.
Will do. I'll fix it before the coffee crew shows.
Saw your sample ballot on the table. Don't vote for somebody just because they promise free everything.
I'm not. I crossed out two names that sounded like they never fixed a fence or paid a shop bill.
Fair. Just check who pays for it.
Truck's near empty. Put $20 in before you take Emily anywhere.
That's what I'm doing. But the ones who want the library open past 5, cheaper first-year classes, and actual broadband have better answers so far.
I will. Her practice pickup is at 11, so I'll leave early.
Saw the envelope by the toaster. Deadline soon?
Yeah. When you went quiet after seeing it, I thought I messed up again.
Need you at Miller's place by 10. Gate latch is bent again.
I can do it. I already grabbed the small grinder and the old hinge from the coffee can.
Truck's got enough gas for town, not for a long wander.
Good. Don't spend all day on the computer before chores.
I'm only going to the library. Need the print estimate and the GED packet.
Good. That shoe-box cash can wait on parks and plane ideas until those are handled.
I know. I just wanted the routes saved before the tabs disappear.
Uploading one pass first. The guy in Berlin asked how I made the rust texture, so I wrote him the steps.
You vanished after sending the thumbnail. Did you submit anything or did the algorithm eat you?
I watched twelve lighting breakdowns and called it reference. Now the file still looks the same.
Cruel twist: the monster was the playlist. Shoes on, no headphones, loop the block, then send me the export.
I haven't been out since yesterday anyway. Setting a 20.
Need the outlet strip in your room or can I borrow it for the charger?
Please leave it. Premiere is rendering and After Effects is still chewing on the title bit.
Fine. Don't cook the laptop.
Trying not to. After that I only have to swap the poster jpgs and push the new page folder.
Are we still going to Ruth and Ed's before the youth supper thing?
Mom said yes, just for pie and to fix Ed's printer.
Tell Ruth no raisin cookies this time. I am begging.
You can tell her yourself in like an hour.
Need your boots out of the truck bed before I load the jack stands.
They're muddy from Caleb's trail thing. I'll move them after dinner.
Put them by the hose, not inside. Your mother already mopped.
Yeah, outside by the hose.
You alive or buried under revision notes
Alive. Running on coffee, peanuts, raisins, and the last container from Saturday.
The red stuff with the beans? Bring that next game night if there is still any.
No promises. I also have pierogi if the container loses the fridge war.
Truck has half a tank. If you go to Gillette, take the red folder from your mom, not loose papers.
I'm not going today. They wanted $95 up front unless the form clears first.
Then call the clinic desk after lunch and ask straight. Same with the pharmacy counter. Get names.
Gas tank was low. Keep the receipt this time.
Okay. I'll write down who says what this time.
Already in my wallet. The truck-tires page gets it after lunch.
Good. Small piles get big when you don't look at them.
Jenna's asking tonight so I have to look at it before then anyway.
Found the trunk tag from old Keller farm stuff. Your mom said you wanted it for the display.
Yeah, if it's not covered in shop dust.
It's fine. Also found the O'Neill tin with the little church cards. On the workbench.
Thanks. I'll move them before Emily turns them into homework props.
The hallway clip is funnier if the tall one blinks before he lies.
I can add two frames. His eyes already look weird because I changed the brush halfway through.
Also the line about the haunted vending machine is better than the freezer one.
Rude but useful. I'll swap that line into the 30 sec version after dinner.
Are you still doing the one story share or did you decide the internet can eat glass
One, maybe. I reread the county writeup and found the NPR segment Mom mentioned.
Good. Add context, no vague flame caption.
That's the plan. I saved the explainer too so I can talk through it Saturday without sounding half-informed.
You skipped the monster's last line in the PDF. Nice try.
It sounded dumb out loud.
Read it anyway at Saturday's table. I will bring red pen and diner fries.
And do the $10 truck-tires transfer before you open the file again. One clean click first.
Before your library shift, please open the spreadsheet and make sure the Sheridan form row is not blank.
It has the link, upload time, and Jenna check time. I just haven't picked the final order.
Pick by lunch. The order matters less than having the receipt email.
Yeah. I don't want another page closing while I'm still moving thumbnails.
County rec called about the unused pass again. Do you want me to cancel it?
Yeah, cancel it. I keep choosing the road by the creek or Caleb's field nights anyway.
Fine, but stretch before you come home limping and pretending you're fine.
Can you help set tables for the church chili thing at 2? Hardware's got me stuck till close.
Yeah, I can. My afternoon is just portfolio edits and maybe the library form.
Lucky. My manager moved next week's hours again and payroll is a mess.
I don't have a manager calendar to fight, so tables are easy.
Game night still at my garage? Bring the red marker if you can find it.
Found it under my tablet stand, somehow next to socks. I'm leaving after I close my laptop.
Truck or legs? My driveway's packed with my uncle's trailer.
Legs. Faster than backing around that thing, and Mrs. Bell's dogs will announce me anyway.
Saw the $20 from Tyler hit your account. Gas tank still under half?
Yeah, using it for gas after I send the final square tonight.
Get the rest before handing over the clean file. Same as any repair job.
Card charge bounced for that drawing program. Need it?
No, I'll use Krita and the old copy on the laptop. Mostly need it for cleaning up stuff before I post.
Good. Don't stack charges. You still doing the town page thing for Saturday times?
Yeah, checking the Facebook event after work. I already put the sketch batch in the server last night.
Mom said you can drive me to the school thing if you do not weird-freeze at the gate.
I do not freeze. I just get quiet when someone with a badge waves cars through.
Same badge guy from the fair smiled at you last time.
Yeah, he was fine. I am still checking both rear lights before we go.
I saw your poster draft for the workshop table. If someone asks what you charge, do not stare into the carpet.
I made a tiny price list. Logos, flyers, weird character cards. Nothing huge.
Good. Also the cafe by the courthouse had a help card taped near the register. Noon-close boxes were checked.
Noon-close is way better than opening. I could do that a few days and still draw at night.
Accountability ping: did you read the little local sheet or did it join the portfolio graveyard?
Read half. Library hours line matters, road thing is confusing, school board bios are shorter than I expected.
Send me a photo of the date box. I will annoy you once, professionally.
Sending. One annoying ping is probably what makes it happen.
Before I leave for the library: please answer Caleb and Jenna so they stop checking with me.
For the community dinner form, I marked one plate for you. Tell me by noon if that changes.
I know. I woke up at 4, made another pot, and then sat at the desk watching brush demos.
One is right. Emily already said she has band stuff, so I am not claiming her fries either.
Open the front door first. Twenty quiet minutes outside, then one message to each person.
And please do not spend the whole morning editing that reply you showed Jenna. Library shift starts at 1.
I closed the notes app. Mostly. I will leave it alone until after shift.
Back. Phone is on the table now. Answering them before I touch YouTube again.
I left the transcript envelope by the scanner. The line with the credits ends right before the senior column starts.
Thanks. Seeing it on paper makes my stomach drop, but I need it for the packet.
One page at a time. Scan it, attach it, then take the portfolio folder to the library table before you edit it again.
Okay. I am bringing the folder before noon even if the walk cycle still bugs me.
Garage after dinner. No disappearing into sword-painting rabbit holes.
I only need to finish the part where the guy explains why the duel shot feels slow.
That is exactly a rabbit hole.
It gave me a better cut for the bandit scene, so I am counting it.
Did you finish pages or did the hilltop sunrise eat the whole morning again?
Pages after. Sunrise first. Then Mom had me sorting donated coats in the hall basement.
You and that basement. Are they still using the same hymn books with the cracked green covers?
Yep. I only touch them when someone needs the piano bench moved, but they are still there.
Did you send the porch-lamp scene or are you still polishing one shadow for the 900th time?
Sent it. Also put up the breakdown because a new kid in the server couldn't get the flicker right.
Look at you, feeding the internet and still making it to the library table tomorrow.
The table matters. Around here, if we want a room for strange little films, somebody has to haul chairs.
Before the library shift, can you check whether the clinic deposit came out? I do not want you surprised at the counter again.
